mod.name: Sawyer Railroads Overhaul Plus
mod.author: Real Track
mod.desc: v0.6 (test: overhead line from North Harbour station to km 6). 3D rails and concrete sleepers on every railway tile of the vanilla map, smoothed curves, dark grey ballast, kilometre and picket posts on the mainland. Track graph raised by 28 cm so trains run on the rail heads.
